scientific_integrity: Prior proof of equal-weight Fock Wigner positivity is cited; originality assigned only to Poisson reset-rate classification and parity split. Complete proof and finite checker supplied; no independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Single zero-temperature bosonic mode; ideal Poisson full-state Fock reset and one-photon loss only; higher even-n thresholds implicit, not explicitly calculated; no experimental cost/feasibility analysis. Wigner positivity does not imply optical P-classicality.
title: Parity-dependent Wigner-negativity threshold under Poisson Fock re-preparation and photon loss
